plain: On April 24, 1964, a police officer named Lonnie Zamora is said to have watched an egg-shaped craft land near Socorro, New Mexico, and found the plants burnt where it had been. The investigator James Fox has looked into the case himself and tells it on two episodes. He gives the exact date and credits Ray Stanford and a document titled "Socorro Saucer in a Pentagon Pantry," and he also mentions J. Allen Hynek. Fox adds the most striking detail: that Zamora had face-to-face contact with one of the beings and "locked eyes" with it. Michels tells the case himself on other episodes. He describes the egg landing and the burnt vegetation, and says the craft "allegedly had little legs." If true, it would be one of the clearest close-range sightings of a landed craft and its occupants by a police officer on duty.
